description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pahala Ambathale, Thirappane D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110594 (23/1200123)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and land ownership claims in specific districts (Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa), which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
